newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-VILLA BREEZE PAST NOTTS COUNTY IN FA CUP.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-VILLA BREEZE PAST NOTTS COUNTY IN FA CUP.

text.p: Two goals from Dwight Yorke and one from Ugo Ehiogu gave premier league Aston Villa a one-sided 3-0 win over second division Notts County in an English F.A. Cup third round replay at Villa Park on Wednesday.
Villa, who reached the semifinals of the cup last season before losing to Liverpool, will play premier league rivals Derby County in the fourth round on Saturday.
Yorke, who missed the the 0-0 draw at Notts County last week with a hamstring injury, put his side ahead after 24 minutes with his 14th strike of the season, cracking home a high loose clearance.
He added a second eight minutes into the second half and Ehiogu completed the victory, heading Villa's third in the 67th minute.

Second division Stockport County, who have knocked premier league sides Blackburn and West Ham out of the League Cup this season, were only five minutes away from another giant-killing act before being held 2-2 by Southampton in their quarter-final.

Stockport, who have never reached the semifinals of a major competition in their 112-year history, fell a goal behind after 16 minutes when Egil Ostenstad scored for the visitors against the run of play.

But two goals in a minute from Alun Armstrong (25th) and Louie Cavaco (26th), whose glancing header went in off a post, tipped the tie Stockport's way and the second division side held their advantage until the 85th minute when Ostenstad scored his second.

The teams will replay at The Dell next Wednesday and the winners will meet Middlesbrough in a two-leg semifinal being played in February and March. Leicester, who beat Ipswich on Tuesday, play Wimbledon in the other semifinal.
